The four-token fixture gives mean 0.825 under both proposals, with variance 2.019375 for uniform sampling and 0.931875 for |a|-proportional sampling. The reported range conservatively includes zero and every proposed success value. The minimax result applies only to the maximum absolute importance-weighted value.

Every item enters the all-40 count at each grid point. A tied top score fails the strict decision check. The oracle midpoint and population-variance widths support descriptive TRAIN scale counts only. Coverage, stopping cost, sampled-shot advantage and L5 remain outside the claim.
